curator_notes: The natural world: ecology and ecosystems.

questions.q: What term describes the variety of life within a given ecosystem?
What is the role of decomposers in an ecosystem?
choices: Break down dead organic matter into nutrients
A network of organisms sharing a habitat
A sequence showing how energy flows from one organism to another
A list of animals competing for the same food

questions.q: Which ecosystem stores the most carbon per unit area?

choices: A close long-term interaction between different species

questions.q: Which gas is most responsible for the greenhouse effect?

choices: A species that only lives in one small area
A species introduced to an area where it is not native, often causing harm
A species that is critically endangered
A species at the top of its food chain

questions.q: The Amazon rainforest is often called 'the lungs of the Earth' because it does what?
choices: Absorbs massive amounts of CO2 and produces oxygen
The most numerous species in an ecosystem
A species with a disproportionately large effect on its ecosystem
The largest predator in a food chain
The first species to colonise a new habitat

questions.q: What does 'endemic' mean when referring to a species?
choices: Native to and found only in a specific place
